instruction.name: vinsgr2vr.b
instruction.description: Insert the low 8 bits of `b` into lane `imm` of `a`; the other lanes are unchanged.

latencies.notes: GPR to lane insert. The round trip with the matching pick measures 6 cycles, and the pick is 3 less, so the insert is 3 cycles. Insert and replace-element latencies are measured with round trips: the insert direction is known from `movgr2fr` (2 cycles) and the picks are 3 for LSX and 5 for LASX, fixed by the vector load chains, so an insert round trip of 6 gives 3 and of 8 gives 3.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
